name: blutrixx/nativephp-audiobook
description: Audiobooks from a voice server: pages fetched in the background, played page after page with the screen off, with lock-screen and headphone controls.

bridge_functions.name: AudioBook.Prepare
bridge_functions.description: Keep a book on the phone (server, key, title, pages) and fetch its voiced pages in the background

bridge_functions.name: AudioBook.Play
bridge_functions.description: Play a prepared book from a page, page after page, with the screen off

bridge_functions.name: AudioBook.Control
bridge_functions.description: pause, resume, toggle, next, prev, stop, speed, seek

bridge_functions.name: AudioBook.State
bridge_functions.description: Where the player is, what a book has on the phone, and the pages heard since the last drain

bridge_functions.name: AudioBook.Delete
bridge_functions.description: Remove a book's audio from the phone
